Ежовик.about: Edible mushroom: neurogenesis and cognition - in vitro and in animals; on people 1 RCT + pilot, the base is small.
Ежовик.caution: Hericium erinaceus (lion's mane). The only abstract in the database is an overview of potential properties. There are VERY few high-quality RCTs on cognitive function in humans. The main data are preclinical. Not to be confused with nootropic effects without evidence base.
Ежовик.food_sources: Edible mushroom (fresh or dried); clinical doses and forms have not been determined.
Ежовик.guidelines: No recommendations: SR 2025 (PMID 40959699) - 5 RCT + 3 pilots, modest data; side effects - GI and allergies.
Ежовик.how_to_choose: There is no standard: take an edible mushroom, not an “extract with neurogenesis”; Allergy sufferers be careful.

Ежовик.myths: “Mushroom nootropic” - in people 1 RCT + pilot (MMSE +1.17). "Neurogenesis" - BDNF/NGF in vitro and in mice. “Harmless” - GI discomfort and allergies.
